name: Fermentation
pages: Some snacks (and many drinks) are made by {b}fermenting{/} them in a {i}keg{/}. It takes about 8 minutes for the ingredients to ferment.{pb}This process also requires the {i}keg{/} to be kept at a certain {b}temperature{/} depending on the recipe.

The temperature can vary based on the {!}biome{/} it's in, but you can use {!}heat sources{/} ({i}campfires{/}, {i}magma blocks{/}, and {i}heating casks{/}) or {!}cold sources{/} ({i}ice{/} or {i}cooling crates{/}) to raise or lower the temperature of a {i}keg{/}.
